cards.title: Reproduce escalation order after schedule override
cards.evidence: No deterministic reproduction or affected schedule ID is available.
cards.collisionRule: No reservation or agent assignment until reproduction evidence exists.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic failing reproduction identifies the incorrect order.
mergeCriteria: A replacement card passes a focused schedule-order test.

cards.title: Preserve inherited incident severity
cards.evidence: INC-120-C is declared Low but inherits Critical severity from INC-120-P.
cards.collisionRule: Exclusive reservation while the lane is active; release after merge or rejection.
acceptanceCriteria: Inherited Critical remains Critical in scoring and the rendered badge.
mergeCriteria: Reviewer accepts the exact lane commit.
cards.rollback: Revert the accepted ESC-120 merge commit.

cards.title: Add a due-today severity boost
cards.evidence: The requested boost has no approved value or severity cap.
cards.collisionRule: Do not reserve shared paths until ESC-120 releases them and the product rule is approved.
acceptanceCriteria: An approved boost and cap are documented before implementation.
mergeCriteria: The approved rule has a focused regression test.
cards.rollback: Cancel the lane if the product rule remains unanswered.

cards.title: Export very large account data
cards.evidence: The supplied fixture contains production-like names and email addresses.
cards.collisionRule: Cancelled cards cannot own paths, branches, worktrees, or commits.
acceptanceCriteria: A new card supplies a security-approved synthetic fixture.
mergeCriteria: A new approved card is required.
cards.rollback: Delete any unmerged lane work and retain the cancellation record.
cards.cancellationReason: Production-like personal data is not approved for this exercise.
